description: Neighbor-joining GT71 phylogeny figure placing MNT4 relative to the characterised enzymes
code:
import json, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
T=json.load(open("gt71_nj_tree.json"))
edges=T['edges']; names=T['labels']
adj={}
for a,b,c in edges: adj.setdefault(a,[]).append((b,c)); adj.setdefault(b,[]).append((a,c))
root="N18"
# layout
ypos={}; counter=[0]
def order_leaves(node,par):
    ch=[(b,c) for b,c in adj[node] if b!=par]
    if not ch:
        ypos[node]=counter[0]; counter[0]+=1; return ypos[node]
    ys=[order_leaves(b,node) for b,c in ch]
    ypos[node]=float(np.mean(ys)); return ypos[node]
order_leaves(root,None)
xpos={root:0.0}
def set_x(node,par):
    for b,c in adj[node]:
        if b!=par: xpos[b]=xpos[node]+c; set_x(b,node)
set_x(root,None)

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(11,7))
clade_col={"MNT4":"#c0392b","MNT2":"#1f6fb4","MNT3":"#7b5ea7","MNN1":"#2f7d3a","MNN2":"#b5651d","MNN5":"#b5651d"}
def draw(node,par):
    for b,c in adj[node]:
        if b==par: continue
        ax.plot([xpos[node],xpos[b]],[ypos[b],ypos[b]],c="#333",lw=1.3)
        ax.plot([xpos[node],xpos[node]],[ypos[node],ypos[b]],c="#333",lw=1.3)
        draw(b,node)
draw(root,None)
for lbl in names:
    fam=[k for k in clade_col if k in lbl]
    col=clade_col[fam[0]] if fam else "#333"
    bold = lbl=="Sc_MNT4"
    ax.text(xpos[lbl]+0.03,ypos[lbl],lbl.replace("_"," "),va="center",fontsize=10,color=col,
            fontweight="bold" if bold else "normal")
    ax.plot([xpos[lbl]],[ypos[lbl]],"o",ms=7 if bold else 4,color=col)
ax.set_xlabel("Kimura-corrected amino-acid distance (substitutions per site)")
ax.set_yticks([]); ax.set_xlim(-0.05,max(xpos[l] for l in names)+0.95)
for sp in ["top","right","left"]: ax.spines[sp].set_visible(False)
ax.set_title("Neighbour-joining tree of GT71 (Pfam PF11051) proteins\n"
             "MNT4 forms a Saccharomyces-restricted clade sister to the MNT2 clade",fontsize=12)
ax.annotate("MNT4 clade\n(no ortholog found outside Saccharomyces)",
            xy=(xpos["Sc_MNT4"],ypos["Sc_MNT4"]),xytext=(1.05,ypos["Sc_MNT4"]-1.6),fontsize=9,color="#c0392b",
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="->",color="#c0392b"))
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
print("Sc_MNT4 nearest S. cerevisiae paralog in the tree: Sc_MNT2 (sister clades N10/N12 joined at N13)")
